description: This file defines the Hyperlinks class responsible for handling hyperlinks within an XLSX worksheet in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods to read hyperlink relationships, set hyperlinks on worksheet cells, and manage hyperlink attributes such as URL and tooltip.

classes.name: Hyperlinks
classes.description: Handles reading and setting hyperlinks in an XLSX worksheet, managing hyperlink relationships and applying them to worksheet cells.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Hyperlinks object with a target Worksheet.

methods.name: readHyperlinks
methods.description: Reads hyperlink relationships from an XML element and stores them internally.

methods.name: setHyperlinks
methods.description: Sets hyperlinks on worksheet cells based on the worksheet XML content.

methods.name: setHyperlink
methods.description: Assigns a hyperlink to specific cells in the worksheet, handling URL and tooltip attributes.
